states: Removal of the test-only resolvePatrolAutonomyLevelForSave / resolvePatrolAutonomySettingsForSave exports; no production code called them.

Embedded production builds (vite build into internal/api/frontend-modern/dist, go build) of the parent 32fad38aa4 and of this change, run on pulse-dev because local memory pressure refused heavy work. The two dists are byte-identical (187 files, every sha256 equal): Rollup had already dropped both helpers.

Each build on its own private DEMO_MODE mock stack with a fresh data dir, one at a time; the same Playwright script ran against both at both widths. Results compared field by field: 6 sessions, 80 recorded fields, 0 differences.

Paid entitlement (ai_autofix added to /api/license/runtime-capabilities via page.route): all four Patrol mode choices enabled; Ask first, Watch only and Autopilot each saved through PUT /api/ai/patrol/autonomy (stubbed 200 plus a GET reconcile rewrite); Autopilot opened the acknowledgement dialog with no PUT until 'Record acknowledgement and activate' (one stubbed acknowledgement POST). Every PUT body carried only autonomy_level, investigation_budget, investigation_timeout_sec and, for Autopilot, acknowledgement_id; none carried full_mode_unlocked.
Runtime lock under demo presentation (ai_autofix blocked with paid_runtime_required): demo forces hideCommercial, so the header shows Watch only with no mode selector and no save path.

Runtime lock with the demo presentation flags cleared in the browser (GET /api/security/status rewritten): 'Pulse Pro runtime required' notice, Watch only selected, Ask first / Safe auto-fix / Autopilot disabled; forced clicks on them sent no PUT and opened no Autopilot dialog; Watch only sent exactly autonomy_level monitor plus the investigation budget and timeout.

Console/network noise identical on both builds and unrelated to the change: 403 POST /api/ai/workflow-prompts/activity (demo write guard on the starter record) in the paid sessions, 404 GET /api/license/commercial-posture in the cleared-presentation sessions.
interactions: Demo auto sign-in; open /patrol, expand 'Mode and automation', read the selector's pressed and disabled states.

Paid: click Ask first, then Watch only, then Autopilot (re-clicking only while the previous save was still reconciling), tick the acknowledgement checkbox and click 'Record acknowledgement and activate'.
Locked (selector visible): force-click Ask first, Safe auto-fix and Autopilot, then click Watch only.
Desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844 contexts; screenshots of the initial, Autopilot dialog and final states inspected.
